proof_summary: Define the candidate sequence by \(L_0=4,L_1=16,L_2=63\) and \(L_{n+3}=4L_{n+2}-L_n\), and consider \(D_n=L_{n+1}^2-L_{n+2}L_n\). Growth estimates together with \(D_{n+3}=4D_{n+1}+D_n\) yield \(0<D_n\le L_n\), so \(L_{n+2}L_n<L_{n+1}^2\le(L_{n+2}+1)L_n\); this forces the ceiling recurrence to produce exactly \(L_{n+2}\), establishing the linear recurrence and hence the generating function.
